host_approvals.filed_question: We check out on Sunday morning but our flight is at night. Is there somewhere to leave our bags for the day?
host_approvals.host_answer: Yes — all three hotels will hold luggage free of charge on checkout day until 20:00. Leave it with reception on your way out and show your room key to collect it.
host_approvals.why: Bells will answer this itself from now on.

host_approvals.filed_question: We're hiring an electric car — is there anywhere to charge it near the venue?
host_approvals.host_answer: There are two public charging points in Ravello, both on the car park at Via della Repubblica. The venue itself has no charger, so plan to charge before you drive up.
